The '''Organized Crime Division''' was a division of the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a law enforcement agency that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Escra Fey'lya]] was a member of it.
